defect.caughtOn: S25+ demo-session mechanical segment; the owner's screenshot (.state/demo-session-2026-10-08/owner-card-evidence.jpg) shows the gate card DISPLAYING '127.0.0.1:8099/subscriptions.html' while the step log recorded 'URL bar holds no page URL - no VIEW intent'
defect.summary: The URL-bar reader returns the bar's VISIBLE text and mobile Chrome OMITS the scheme, so the card URL ('127.0.0.1:8099/subscriptions.html') does not start with http(s):// — the restore's old http(s)-prefix guard rejected it AND the lastKnownPageUrl tracking never captured it. The JVM tests passed because they used fully-schemed URLs. The guard was written against a fiction: the loop's per-step URL-of-record has been scheme-less on real Chrome all along.

fix.mechanism: One helper at the normalization point, normalizePageUrl(raw): String? — trims; fully-schemed http(s) returns as-is; scheme-less text whose part before any slash looks like a host (dotted host[:port], localhost, [::1]) gets the scheme PREPENDED (loopback hosts -> http, else https); everything else (about:blank, the hidden sentinel, blank) -> null. Deterministic. notePageUrl now tracks the NORMALIZED value (scheme-less bar reads are last-known-tracked). restoreBrowserForeground serves the first chain candidate that normalizes and fires the VIEW intent with the normalized URL; the serving log line notes '(normalized)' when normalization changed the value. Everything else byte-identical: the chain order (card -> observation -> last-known), the loud no-URL line, the overlay/never-fronting/trusted/task-ending exclusions, restore-before-execute ordering, Config.restoreSettleMs. NOTE: the old usablePageUrl(Boolean) was FOLDED INTO normalizePageUrl (the single helper the dispatch called for) — its lastKnownPageUrl-gate behavior is exactly 'normalizePageUrl(raw) != null', now also stored normalized.

deviations: Test host: the dispatch offered en.wikipedia.org for the non-loopback case or example.test if the site-name rule is stricter — used example.test (generic reserved TLD; the repo's verifier precedent checks 'zero new site strings')
usablePageUrl removed (folded into normalizePageUrl) rather than kept as a wrapper — no dead code; behavior of the dispatch's item 2 preserved (scheme-less bar text now tracked, normalized)
